name: MLonMCU
description: While there exist many ways to deploy machine learning models on microcontrollers, it is non-trivial to choose the optimal combination of frameworks and targets for a given application. Thus, automating the end-to-end benchmarking flow is of high relevance nowadays. A tool called MLonMCU is proposed in this paper and demonstrated by benchmarking the state-of-the-art TinyML frameworks TFLite for Microcontrollers and TVM effortlessly with a large number of configurations in a low amount of time.
reputation: Moderate adoption in the TinyML community as a practical open-source end-to-end benchmarking tool for microcontroller deployments.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; hardware-dependent results (MCU, compiler, board) with high configuration variance; not a single-task dataset—reports often combine accuracy, binary size, memory, and latency.
